patch_description:
Inspired by earlier motif-discovery candidates that placed three-qubit ZZZ motifs on the eight winning lines and symmetry-grouped single-qubit rotations, this design streamlines the ansatz to improve parameter efficiency and generalization. Key changes:

- Remove the pre-entangling RZ layer to reduce parameter count and discourage overfitting (keeps lightweight local RY and a shared post-RZ).
- Consolidate the center-edge controlled-phase into a single shared CRZ parameter (crz_center_edge) across all four center edges to respect rotational symmetry while cutting parameters.
- Keep ZZZ motifs aligned to horizontal/vertical/diagonal winning lines (zzz_h, zzz_v, zzz_d) — these are expressive, physically meaningful motifs for motif-discovery.
- Add a single RX on the center qubit (rx_center) to give an explicit handle for "draw" detection without blowing up parameter count.

Together these changes drop the per-block parameter count substantially (from 14 -> 11), reducing total parameters and gate depth while retaining geometric motif expressivity. This should improve validation/test generalization, lower L2 loss, and speed training convergence.
